results.title: Cognitive Risk Management in Brokerage Services
results.content: It bridges traditional risk control mechanisms with cutting-edge methodologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs) such as GPT-4o, GPT-5 (upcoming), Claude 3.7, Llama 4.0, and OpenAI o1/o3; Agentic AI for autonomous monitoring and surveillance; Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) for strategic simulation and workflow orchestration; Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for network-based risk modeling; Reinforcement Learning (RL) for adaptive limit setting and optimization; and Neuro-symbolic AI for auditable and rule-compliant decision automation.
